name: Equilor
description: One of the most ancient and distant planes, inhabited by long-lived humanlike beings; known mainly from Urza's visit.

description_citations.text: "Equilor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Xantcha travel to Equilor seeking the origin of the Phyrexians, taking over a thousand years to find it.
timeline.quote: It took them far more than a thousand years to find the plane.

citation.text: "Equilor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elders tell Urza the Phyrexians could not reach Dominaria because of the Shard of the Twelve Worlds.
timeline.quote: told him that the Phyrexians couldn't reach Dominaria because of the Shard of the Twelve Worlds

citation.text: "Equilor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza plans to turn Equilor into a mechanical paradise, which most elders reject.
timeline.quote: his intrusive plans weren't received well by the majority of the elders

citation.text: "Equilor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Told the Shard was destroyed, Urza planeswalks away from Equilor, never to return, to prepare Dominaria for invasion.
timeline.quote: Urza planeswalked away to prepare Dominaria for certain invasion

citation.text: "Equilor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: seeks Equilor's inhabitants for information on Phyrexia's origin
relations.quote: Its inhabitants have significant insight on other planes, which leads Urza to seek them out for information on the origin of Phyrexia and the Shard of the Twelve Worlds
